historical_references.reference: Bijit, also known as Vijayasena, was a king of the Sena Dynasty in Bengal, ruling from 1120 to 1150 CE.
Another Bijit, a Hindu king of the Kuninda Dynasty in ancient India, is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a contemporary of Bhishma Pitamaha.
